value.rationale: The five-cut stage is known to exhibit a canonical integral two-torsion class. This result computes the adjacent six-cut topology and the previously undetermined connecting map, showing that the torsion class is exactly the image of a torsion-free rank-26 source, a structural filtration invariant not determined by separate homology groups. The six-cut complex is also a natural nonshellable pure five-dimensional example.
